GrandTotal.Amount — Confidence: High (~95%)
- Evidence: Multiple clear occurrences: "Gesamt 600,00 EUR", "BETRAG 600,00 EUR", and "total 600.00 EUR" in English section. Consistent labels indicating invoice total. Decimal format preserved.

Invoice.Date — Confidence: Moderate-High (~85%)

Sender.VatId — Confidence: High (~90%)
- Evidence: UID shown as "CHE-106.847.567 MWST" near sender block. This matches Swiss UID format and is explicitly labeled UID/MWST. Clear match to sender tax ID.

Vat.Rate — Confidence: High (~95%)
- Evidence: VAT shown as "0,00 %" next to line item and net lines. Explicitly printed; unambiguous. Extracted as numeric "0" per rule to omit percent sign.

Net.Amount — Confidence: High (~90%)
- Evidence: "Netto 0,00 % 600,00 EUR" indicates net amount 600,00 EUR. Multiple occurrences show 600.00 as net. Formatting preserved.

Vat.Amount — Confidence: High (~95%)
- Evidence: VAT amount displayed as "0,00" (percent and amount), consistent with 0% VAT applied; VAT monetary amount implied zero. Clear and consistent.

Overall notes:
- Main uncertainty is Invoice.Date due to multiple dates on document (service dates, loading dates, header timestamps). Other numeric fields clearly labeled and consistent.
